newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat pledges cooperation with new U.S. team.
newsitem.headline: Arafat pledges cooperation with new U.S. team.

text.p: The Palestinian Authority responded to U.S. President Bill Clinton's nomination of new secretaries of state and defence on Thursday by pledging continued cooperation with Washington on Middle East peace.
Both U.N. ambassador Madeleine Albright, named as secretary of state, and Senator William Cohen, nominated as Pentagon chief, are widely regarded in Israel as pro-Israeli.

"We will continue working with the (new) American administration...with the sincerity, honesty and frankness that characterised our relations with the previous administration under President Clinton," Marwan Kanafani, a spokesman for Palestinian President Yasser Arafat, told Reuters.
The Palestinian Authority is in charge of self-rule areas in the West Bank and Gaza Strip under peace deals signed with the Jewish state.
